title: Day-Count Conventions for Re-dated Installments by Return Channel — Payment Arrangements
content:
When an installment of a plan under Payment Arrangements is re-dated after a returned payment, the way the re-dating lead plus the re-dating verification buffer is counted from the clock start follows the channel of the plan's most recent returned installment payment.

## Convention

- After an ACH bank debit return, the lead plus buffer is counted in business days, Monday to Friday, after the clock start, the clock start itself not counted; the new due date is the business day reached.
- After a debit card or credit card return, it is counted in calendar days, and a new due date that lands on a Saturday or a Sunday moves to the following Monday.
- After a return on any other channel, it is counted in calendar days.

The channel is the payment channel carried on the most recent returned installment payment of the plan.

## Convention table

| Channel of the most recent returned installment payment | Days counted | Weekend landing |
|---|---|---|
| ACH bank debit | Business days, Monday to Friday, after the clock start | Cannot land on a weekend |
| Debit card or credit card | Calendar days | Saturday or Sunday moves to the following Monday |
| Any other channel | Calendar days | Stays where it lands |

## Worked counts (hypothetical clock starts; lead plus buffer of 7 days)

| Clock start | Channel | Counting | New due date |
|---|---|---|---|
| A Thursday | ACH bank debit | Fri 1, Mon 2, Tue 3, Wed 4, Thu 5, Fri 6, Mon 7 | The Monday 11 calendar days after the clock start |
| A Thursday | Debit card | 7 calendar days | The following Thursday, 7 calendar days later |
| A Monday | Credit card | 7 calendar days lands on the next Monday | 7 calendar days later |
| A Wednesday | Check by mail | 7 calendar days | The following Wednesday |

With a lead plus buffer of 3 days from a Wednesday, a card return lands on the Saturday and moves to the Monday, 5 calendar days after the clock start; an ACH return counts Thursday, Friday and Monday, also reaching the Monday 5 calendar days after the clock start. From a Saturday clock start, an ACH count of 1 business day reaches the Monday.
